## Importing Data

1.  Import the data

```{r}
# Response Variable
democracy <-read_csv("Data/democracy2020.csv")   
# Predictor Variables 
CO2_emissions <-read_csv("Data/co2_cons.csv")
gdp <-read_csv("Data/gdp_pcap.csv")
humanDevIndx <-read_csv("Data/hdi_human_development_index.csv")
poverty<-read_csv("Data/number_of_people_in_poverty.csv")
gapminder_2025<-read_csv("Data/gapminder_2025.csv") # QUALITATIVE (regions) 
```

## Wrangling Data

TODO: 1. Combine all the data into a large dataset

*NOTE:* We will use the last recorded year for the datasets that do not
have a 2025 entry.

```{r}
data_lst<- list(CO2_emissions, gdp, humanDevIndx, poverty, gapminder_2025)

Full_2025<-life_exp 
for (dataset in data_lst){  
  Full_2025 <- Full_2025|>
    full_join(dataset, by="geo")
}

Full_2025<-Full_2025|>
  select(geo,name.x,`2025.x`, # keep life_exp 2025 columns
         `2022.y`, # keep 2025 co2 column
         `2025.y`,  # keep 2025 gdp column
         `2023.x.x`,  # keep 2025 humanDevIdnx column
         `2025`,     # keep 2025 poverty column
         world_4region # keep 2025 regions column
         )|>
  rename(name = name.x, #rename columns for clarity
         life_Exp=`2025.x`,
         CO2=`2022.y`,
         GDP=`2025.y`,
         Poverty = `2025`,
         HumDevIndx= `2023.x.x`
         ) 
```
